notes.title: Unit Buffs!
notes.content:
Some unit changes here!

Transport units do more dmg (except armored lander), try out the new digger on a turret, that thing now does way more.

Another big change is commissars can now capture properties. Does this make them the strongest unique unit in the game? maybe. Idk. But it def does make them more fun.

notes.title: Tweaks and changes
notes.content:
Fullscreen no longer makes a blue square appear

Broadcast towers don't crash the game when you save

Your settings are now saved when you close and re enter the game

You can now build bridges across single ocean tiles

notes.title: Steam remote play now works!
notes.content:
It's come to my attention that steam remote play didn't work because the steam overlay didn't appear in game. Now it all works fine!

Additionally, now you can right click to unselect a unit or building, so no more accidentally moving a guy while trying to click off of him.
